name: NEMA-17 42 mm hybrid stepper, 40 mm body
uncertainty: Novanta NEMA17 drawing gives 42.3 mm frame, body lengths 34/40/48 mm, 5 mm shaft, 22 mm pilot, 31 mm mounting pattern (4x M3). Rear boss height and cable exit diameter are not tabulated; modelled from the family drawing.
mass_source: NEMA-17 42 mm 40 mm-body steppers are published in the 200-280 g class; 276 g used.
material: Laminated steel stack, aluminium end plates, black epoxy
